Counsel for Opposite Party :- A.G.A.
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 31.03.1993 passed by learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, Bijnor in Criminal Appeal No. 11 of 1992, arising out of judgment and order dated 22.01.1992 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate IIIrd, Bijnor in Case No. 2775 of 1990, under Section 7/17 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, convicting revisionist and sentencing six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- and in default of non-payment of fine, he shall further suffer six months simple imprisonment.

3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
